Commitments of Traders — Dashboard PositionsCFTCPricesBarchart

Positions: the U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission's Commitments of Traders report (Legacy, futures only), taken from the CFTC's public reporting API — published weekly, Fridays 15:30 US Eastern; a work of the US Government and in the public domain. Prices: weekly bars of the nearest futures contract from barchart.com. The products and their categories are those on barchart's Commitments of Traders page; every product uses the Legacy report's trader groups. History runs back to 2000, or to the contract's first report. Non-Commercial = large speculators, Commercial = hedgers, Non-Reportable = small traders. Net position = long − short. Percentile ranks and Stochastic %K are computed as described on each chart.

Provided for information only. This is not investment advice, and no warranty is given as to the accuracy or completeness of the figures shown.
